UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
PRESS NOTE / IMPORTANT NOTICE
SUBJECT: EXTENSION OF LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF ONLINE APPLICATIONS - CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026

In continuation of Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSP dated 14.02.2026 published by the Union Public Service Commission for Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026, it is hereby informed that due to server maintenance and candidate requests, the competent authority has decided to grant an extension of last date.
The closing date for submission of online applications is extended to 10.03.2026 up to 18:00 Hours.
All other terms and conditions mentioned in Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSP remain unchanged.
